description:
Discover and scrape a whole site by following links, as a durable background job (POST /crawl).
Returns 202 metadata with the job id. Poll with crawl_status. Completed jobs expose one ZIP per
format with a manifest.json mapping files to source URLs. Scope it first: an unscoped crawl of
a large site burns credits fast, and map_site shows what a crawl would hit for one cheap call.
API docs: https://apidocs.pline.ai/guides/endpoints/crawl

events.description: Events to send: started, page, completed, failed. Empty means all supported events.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers sent with each event.

metadata.description: Optional JSON metadata included in each event.

url.description: Public HTTPS endpoint receiving job events.

actions.description: Browser steps run on every page after load; implies a browser.

allow_subdomains.description: Include subdomains of the seed's domain.

crawl_entire_domain.description: Allow leaving the seed's path prefix.

email.description: Address notified when the crawl completes.

geolocation.description: Fetch every page as a visitor from this 2-letter ISO country.

heartbeat_timeout_secs.description: Workflow heartbeat timeout in seconds. Default 30.

ignore_robots_txt.description: Ignore robots.txt while discovering URLs. Default true.

include_paths.description: Regexes; only matching paths are crawled.

js_render.description: Same meaning as on scrape, applied to every page fetch.

limit.description: Maximum pages (1-10000). Default 10000, matching the API. Confirm scope for large sites.

only_main_content.description: Strip navigation, footer, and ads from cleaned outputs.

output.description: Formats to store, any of markdown, html, clean_html, links, screenshot, screenshot_full_page. Default ["markdown"].

proxy_strategy.description: Same meaning as on scrape, applied to every page fetch.

schedule_to_close_timeout_secs.description: Workflow schedule-to-close deadline in seconds. Default 86400.

sitemap.description: include: use sitemaps plus links; only: sitemaps alone; skip: ignore sitemaps. Default include.

tag.description: Up to 25 labels echoed in usage logs.

url.description: Seed URL; the crawl follows links from here.

wait_ms.description: Extra settle wait in milliseconds per browser-rendered page (0-60000).

wait_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for on every browser-rendered page.

webhook.description: Full event webhook configuration. Use this instead of webhook_url for headers, metadata, or event selection.

webhook_url.description: Public HTTPS URL receiving started/page/completed/failed events.

name: crawl_start
